specs.Item Highlight: High-speed data transfer and 4K video recording with 280MB/s read speed, V60 rating and 128GB capacity

features: UNMATCHED SPEED - Experience rapid file transfers with up to 280MB/s read and 210MB/s write speeds, thanks to UHS-II technology, drastically reducing your workflow time for large files.
AMPLE STORAGE - With a generous 128GB capacity, this SDXC card provides substantial space for high-resolution photos, 4K UHD video, and more, ensuring you never miss a critical shot.
ULTIMATE DURABILITY - Designed to withstand harsh conditions, this card operates flawlessly from 32°F to 158°F, and tolerates storage temperatures from -13°F to 185°F, ensuring data safety.
PROFESSIONAL RELIABILITY - The Lexar Gold Series offers dependable performance for photographers and videographers, backed by a lifetime limited warranty for peace of mind and long-term use.
BROAD COMPATIBILITY - Fully compliant with SDXC UHS-II devices and supports Class 10, U3, and V60 speed classes, ensuring seamless operation with a wide range of cameras and equipment.
OPTIMIZED WORKFLOW - Accelerate your post-production with quick offloads and efficient editing, leveraging the card's high-speed capabilities to streamline your creative process from start to finish.
description: Designed for your DSLR or mirrorless cameras, the Lexar(R) Professional 1800x SDXC(TM) UHS- II Card GOLD Series lets you quickly capture and transfer high-quality photos and stunning Full-HD and 4K video with read speeds up to 280 MB/s and write speeds up to 205/210 MB/s. With the latest UHS-II technology and a Video Speed Class 60 (V60) rating, this card dramatically accelerates your workflow from start to finish.
